{{Quote|I'll sweep the outer corridor, while the rest of your ships focus on the center.''"<br />"''Are you sure you want to go it alone?''"<br />"''I'm sure. More than one fighter will just draw too much attention.|Anakin Skywalker and Captain Rex|audio=SweepTheOuterCorridor-DoaD.flac|<ref name="Downfall of a Droid" />}}
[[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] undertook a '''mission''' to scout ahead in an area of suspected [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] [[Realspace/Legends|space]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Skywalker was accompanied by a replacement [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]], [[R3-S6/Legends|R3-S6]], as his original [[Droid/Legends|droid]], [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]], had been lost previously during the Republic's [[Battle of Bothawui/Legends|defense]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bothawui/Legends|Bothawui]]. However, Skywalker was unaware that R3-S6 was a [[Spy/Legends|spy]] working for the Confederate [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]]. Once the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] arrived in the target area in [[Anakin Skywalker's Delta-7B Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|his starfighter]], R3-S6 alerted Grievous to Skywalker's presence, and the [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] general ambushed the Jedi with several [[Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|''Munificent''-class frigates]]. Skywalker engaged Grievous's forces, but the Jedi was able to escape with the aid of his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], and [[Clone Captain/Legends|Clone Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|CT-7567]], when they arrived and rescued him with Skywalker's personal [[Starship/Legends|ship]], the [[Twilight/Legends|''Twilight'']].

==Prelude==
{{Dialogue|Kenobi|Our intelligence has confirmed that Grievous's spies have been intercepting our transmissions.|Tano|He must have some sort of secret listening post out there somewhere.|Skywalker|That would explain how he's been able to ambush our fleets|attr=Obi-Wan Kenobi, Ahsoka Tano and Anakin Skywalker|audio=InterceptedTransmissions-DoaD.flac|src=<ref name="Downfall of a Droid" />}}
[[File:Skytop_Station.png|thumb|left|180px|Skytop Station]]
In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], the first [[Standard year/Legends|year]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]],<ref name="Downfall of a Droid Date" /> the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] built [[Skytop Station/Legends|Skytop Station]],<ref name="Prelude">''[[The Clone Wars: Prelude]]''</ref> a [[Listening post/Legends|listening post]] over the [[Ruusan 2/Legends|Ruusan moon]].<ref name="Duel of the Droids Ep Guide">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode007.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Duel of the Droids}}</ref> The [[Space station/Legends|station]] intercepted [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] transmissions, and the Confederacy began to use the information to ambush Republic forces.<ref name="DB Katuunko">{{DB|character|katuunko|Katuunko, King}}</ref>

After [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] engaged in a [[Battle of Bothawui/Legends|successful defense]] of the strategically important [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Bothawui/Legends|Bothawui]], he and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Jedi Commander/Legends|Jedi Commander]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], went with his [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] of three [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyers]] to the [[Allanteen VI shipyards/Legends|Allanteen Six shipyards]] where the [[Cruiser/Legends|cruisers]] had been manufactured, believing that the vessels could use modifications.<ref name="Wild Space" />

Eventually, [[High Jedi General/Legends|High Jedi General]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] contacted Skywalker at the [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyards]]<ref name="Wild Space" /> and reported that [[Republic Intelligence/Legends|Republic Intelligence]]<ref name="Downfall of a Droid Ep Guide" /> had confirmed the existence of a Confederate listening post that had been intercepting Republic transmissions.<ref name="Wild Space" /> Kenobi gave Skywalker the new mission of finding the Confederate listening post.<ref name="Downfall of a Droid" /> Skywalker elected to undertake the sweeps of outer corridors of [[Realspace/Legends|space]] suspected of Confederate activity, while the rest of his forces concentrated on a more central path.<ref name="Downfall of a Droid Ep Guide" /> Skywalker departed in his [[Anakin Skywalker's Delta-7B Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|Delta-7B starfighter]] with a [[Syliure-31 hyperspace docking ring/Legends|hyperspace docking ring]], and was accompanied by [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] [[R3-S6/Legends|R3-S6]], who had replaced [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]], Skywalker's original droid, after he had been lost during the Battle of Bothawui.<ref name="Downfall of a Droid" /> Unbeknownst to the Jedi, R3-S6 was a [[Spy/Legends|spy]] working for the Confederate [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]], intent on removing Skywalker as an obstacle.<ref name="Duel of the Droids" />

==The mission==
{{Quote|A-ha! There's our Jedi tracking beacon. Skywalker, now you have fallen into ''my'' trap!|General Grievous|audio=JediTrackingBeacon-DoaD.flac|<ref name="Downfall of a Droid" />}}
Arriving in an area of space suspected of Confederate activity,<ref name="Downfall of a Droid Ep Guide" /> Skywalker ordered R3-S6 to activate the [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter's]] [[scanner]]s. However, the droid instead activated the fighter's [[Homing beacon/Legends|homing beacon]], intending to alert Grievous of Skywalker's presence. Back with the fleet, Tano picked up the signal. Alarmed, she ordered [[Clone Captain/Legends|Clone Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|CT-7567]], nicknamed "Rex," to gather [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] to rescue Skywalker with the [[G9 Rigger-class light freighter/Legends|G9 ''Rigger''-class light freighter]] [[Twilight/Legends|''Twilight'']], Skywalker's personal [[Starship/Legends|ship]]. Grievous arrived in the [[Star system/Legends|system]] out of [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] with two [[Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|''Munificent''-class frigates]], which began to attack Skywalker with [[Laser/Legends|laser]] fire.<ref name="Downfall of a Droid" />

[[File:Between_those_tin_cans.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The ''Twilight'' maneuvers between the frigates.]]
Skywalker ordered R3-S6 to plot a course out of the system and prep the [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] [[Hyperspace transport ring/Legends|booster engines]], but the droid instead dropped the booster ring, not intending to allow the Jedi to escape. The engines were destroyed by laser fire, and Skywalker, unable to retreat, was forced to engage the [[Frigate/Legends|frigates]]. Grievous ordered all of the frigates' [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|vulture droids]] to be launched, and the [[Droid starfighter/Legends|droid fighters]] targeted [[Missile/Legends|missiles]] at the fleeing Jedi fighter. Ordering R3-S6 to cut his fighter's engines, Skywalker turned around to face his fighter at the droids, aiming laser blasts at the group of approaching missiles. The missiles were destroyed, and Grievous ordered the frigates to move into attack position.<ref name="Downfall of a Droid" />

As the Vulture droids approached, Skywalker was able to destroy several of the fighters, but under the cover of incapability, R3-S6 refused to activate the engines or fire the laser guns of Skywalker's fighter. The ''Twilight'' soon arrived out of hyperspace with Rex and Tano aboard, and, as the [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] engaged the droids, Skywalker was able to [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] his fighter into the freighter's [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]]. The ''Twilight'' escaped by maneuvering between the wings of [[Grievous's Munificent-class star frigate (suspected Confederate space)/Legends|Grievous's frigate]] and its sister ship, and the droid fighters pursuing the freighter were destroyed. As the ''Twilight'' jumped to hyperspace, Grievous took his frustration out on a [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]], swatting and destroying it.<ref name="Downfall of a Droid" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|He's still out there. I ''know'' it.|Anakin Skywalker, on R2-D2|audio=HesStillOutThere-DownfallOfADroid.flac|<ref name="Downfall of a Droid" />}}
Even though he had escaped, Skywalker was left frustrated with R3-S6, as the Jedi still longed for the return of his original astromech droid, R2-D2.<ref name="Downfall of a Droid" /> The ''Twilight'' soon received a communication from R2-D2, who was being taken to Skytop Station by Gha Nachkt to be sold to Grievous. Tracking the droid and discovering the Confederate listening post over the [[Ruusan/Legends|Ruusan]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]], Skywalker contacted Kenobi and reported the location of the droid. Despite the fact that R2-D2 was aboard the station, Kenobi ordered Skywalker to destroy the base; the droid had fallen into enemy hands, and it would prove fatal to the Republic if Grievous gained the information stored in his databanks. Skywalker and Tano led the [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Troop/Legends|troopers]] aboard the ''Twilight'' on a [[Raid on Skytop Station/Legends|mission]] to destroy the station; however, against Kenobi's wishes, Skywalker decided to rescue R2-D2 as well.<ref name="Duel of the Droids" />

==Behind the scenes==
The mission was created for "[[Downfall of a Droid]]," an episode that aired on [[November 7]], [[2008]], as part of the [[The Clone Wars: Season One|first season]] of the television series ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]''.<ref name="Downfall of a Droid Ep Guide" />

The prelude to the mission&mdash;namely, the Battle of Bothawui and the search aboard the ''Vulture's Claw'' for R2-D2&mdash;was mentioned in the [[December]] 2008 novel ''[[The Clone Wars: Wild Space]]'', written by [[Karen Miller]]. The novel introduced continuity problems, as it stated that Skywalker and Tano returned to the Alanteen Six shipyards after their search for R2-D2 aboard the ''Vulture's Claw''.<ref name="Wild Space" /> "Downfall of a Droid"&mdash;in which both the mission to the ''Vulture's Claw'' and Skywalker's sweeps of space were first featured&mdash;had stated that Skywalker's mission to suspected Confederate space took place directly after the mission to the ''Vulture's Claw''.<ref name="Downfall of a Droid" /> This article assumes that the novel's interpretation of events is correct.
